entities.summary: Eszter Krutzler is a female weightlifter from Hungary. She became an Olympic medalist during the 2004 Summer Olympics when she won the silver medal in the women's – 69 kg class. Eszter Krutzler was a athletes & competitors from Szombathely (b. 1981-03-04, Szombathely). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
